features.description: Backend image injection, AG-UI-native + non-retaining. Images ride forwardedProps.attachments as base64; a make_image_injector before_model_callback (mirroring make_document_injector) injects a user Content with Part(inline_data=Blob(bytes,mime)) before the model call, then clears it (no GCS/Firestore/artifact). multimodal_input flag on SkillConfig; attachment metadata-only logged.
acceptance_criteria: forwardedProps.attachments ([{mimeType,data(base64),name}]) extracted (mirror _extract_document_ids) + stashed in session state
make_image_injector before_model_callback builds a user Content with an image Part per attachment, before the model call, then clears state (non-retention)
callback wired into the agent factory; multimodal_input bool flag on SkillConfig parsed from frontmatter
no image bytes persisted to GCS/Firestore/artifacts (pytest asserts); attachment metadata-only (count/mime/size) logged
make lint clean; make test-fast green
features.notes: SHIPPED 6fbbe92. make_image_injector (adk/callbacks/image.py) + _extract_attachments + stash + multimodal_input flag + parser. 7 tests incl non-retention; make test-fast 1819. DOCPARSE_API_KEY wired into cloudbuild --set-secrets (docs route to docparse, images to Gemini).

features.description: Frontend upload UI: paperclip + camera capture + thumbnail (max 4); on-device no-person guardrail (FaceDetector, graceful degrade); client-side resize to 2048px -> base64 into sendMessage opts -> forwardedProps.attachments; gate on multimodal_input; units-loop + ## Image input SKILL.md blocks.
acceptance_criteria: paperclip + camera button in the chat composer, gated on the skill's multimodal_input; accepts jpeg/png/heic/pdf
selected file -> thumbnail with remove; max 4/turn; client-side resize to 2048px longest edge
on-device no-person guardrail blocks a detected person with a retake prompt (mocked detector in tests); graceful degrade when FaceDetector unavailable (notice, no over-block)
send composes attachments (base64) into sendMessage -> forwardedProps; units-loop + ## Image input block added to the 3 tutor SKILL.md
features.notes: SHIPPED. lib/imageResize.ts (pure computeTargetSize/stripDataUrlPrefix + canvas resize→2048px JPEG q0.85, heic passthrough) + lib/personGuardrail.ts (pure evaluatePersonScreen + screenImageForPerson via Shape Detection FaceDetector, graceful degrade = allow+notice, never over-block). Staging owned by hooks/useImageAttachments.ts (cap 4, guardrail block, objectURL cleanup); presentational components/chat/ImageComposer.tsx (ImageStagingRow + ImageUploadButtons paperclip/camera). Wired: useSkillAgent.sendMessage opts.attachments→forwardedProps.attachments; useSkillMeta.multimodalInput gate; page.tsx handleSend sends base64 + clears (image-only turn allowed). 22 FE tests. ARCH CHANGE from plan: the '## Image input' units-loop guidance is NOT inlined per-SKILL.md — problem-set-hints body was already ~118 chars under the 10k SkillConfig cap, so an inline block overflowed it (test_real_skill_templates_instructions_under_10k_limit went red). Instead it's a SHARED backend preamble (backend/skills/preambles/image_input.md) injected at agent build by adk/multimodal.py inject_image_input_preamble(instructions, multimodal_input), gated on the flag, mirroring inject_interaction_style_preamble (1.1.20). DRY + cap-safe + auto-applies to any future multimodal skill. Frontmatter multimodalInput:true added to all 3 tutors. Backend gate: lint clean, test-fast 1823 + injector test. FE gate: quality:check exit 0.
